scope: JSDOM text/events and actual numerical Roadster solver reports through a Worker endpoint facade. No browser layout, GPU pixels, native Worker timing or FPS acceptance.

evidence.name: Input-only numeric edits immediately save the valid next-run request; partial edits keep it and rebuilding restores it independently of historical selection
evidence.eventPath: input only; no numeric change or later select change

evidence.name: Load historical configuration copies all request controls without running, changing the live vehicle or overwriting the selected response
Running the loaded history creates a new current-model record with declared provenance and explicit wet-road / assist labels
Selected old history and the exact completed pending request survive reopening and rebuilding independently
Editing while a frozen request runs cannot mark the new request as completed; restoring the executed conditions finds the real batch
Failure and a partially cancelled pair keep distinct execution states, frozen requests and returned reports
Interrupted browser execution is not reported as successful and a build mismatch cannot inherit a completed status
English research panels, chart labels and prompts use presentation strings while JSON/CSV, user names and physical state stay unchanged
Switching back restores Chinese presentation and preserves editable numeric configuration
